title: Homework in the Library
setting: A quiet school library with wooden desks and many books.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts)

characters.name: Mia
characters.look: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans)

characters.name: Kofi
characters.look: Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt)

sentences.en: Two students, Ben and Mia, enter the library.
sentences.zh: 两个学生，本和米娅，走进图书馆。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans), with school bags, walk into a quiet school library with tall shelves of books.

sentences.en: Kofi lets them sit at a big desk.
sentences.zh: 科菲让他们坐在一张大书桌旁。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt) smiles and points to a big wooden desk for Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans).

sentences.en: Mia does her French reading first.
sentences.zh: 米娅先做她的法语阅读。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) reads a book with a picture of the Eiffel Tower on the cover at the desk.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Mia reading a book about Paris; that it is French homework can't be shown exactly.

sentences.en: Ben practises his English writing in a notebook.
sentences.zh: 本在笔记本上练习英语写作。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) writes carefully in a notebook at the desk, a pencil in his hand.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Ben writing in a notebook; that it is English can't be shown.

sentences.en: He writes each new word again and again.
sentences.zh: 他把每个新单词写了一遍又一遍。
sentences.scene_prompt: Close view of Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) writing; his notebook page is full of rows of small handwriting squiggles.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Ben writing the same thing in many rows; the words themselves can't be shown.

sentences.en: Grammar is hard, and maths is even harder.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) scratches his head over an open maths book with triangles and circles, a grammar book beside it.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Ben struggling with his books; the comparison 'even harder' can't be shown.

sentences.en: Mia checks his answers, and they are correct.
sentences.zh: 米娅检查了他的答案，都是对的。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) puts big red ticks next to his friend's work in the notebook while Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) watches.

sentences.en: Ben cannot believe it and smiles at Mia.
sentences.zh: 本简直不敢相信，冲着米娅笑了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) looks at the red ticks with wide eyes and a big smile, and Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) smiles back.
